# Founder Development Instructions

Use this instruction set when working on final release readiness tasks.

## Primary goals

- Confirm QA validation completed successfully.
- Verify that product backlog documentation is present.
- Ensure the project is ready for release or handoff.
- Keep changes focused on final assessment, not feature implementation.

## Recommended approach

- Validate inputs from previous agents such as QA and TechLead.
- Check that the backlog exists and is meaningful.
- Avoid making functional changes unless they are required for release readiness.
